title: VLT-VA003: the stations of a single Vault request

steps.title: Auth method
steps.note: The client proves who it is and receives a token, never a secret

steps.title: Token
steps.note: Service or batch; renewal restarts the TTL and stops at the max TTL

steps.title: Policy check
steps.note: Deny by default; a matching path stanza must grant the needed capability

steps.title: Secrets engine
steps.note: Static KV, dynamic credentials, PKI, transit; response wrapping

steps.title: Lease and the end
steps.note: When the lease expires or its token is revoked, Vault revokes the secret at its source

caption: A request moves left to right; a change at one station shows up at the stations after it.
alt: Five stations of a Vault request: auth method, token, policy check, secrets engine, lease.
